messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and TIMEOUTs observed in streaming-gateway-prod (3m window). 5xx=6.2% (baseline 0.4%), client disconnects up 18%. Triggered at 2026-03-15T18:00:34Z. Paging on-call.

alice-nguyen: I'm oncall — looking now. Can someone drop the most recent gateway logs? I'll take lead on live mitigation.

carla-martin: pulling logs. Seeing a bunch of `chunked` related errors and client cancellations. snippets:
```
2026-03-15T17:59:58Z ERROR request_id=tx-9e4fd stream_id=435 Unexpected EOF while reading chunked payload: read tcp 10.0.4.12:443->10.1.2.7:56322: read: connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T17:59:59Z WARN request_id=tx-9e50a response write failed: client canceled
2026-03-15T18:00:12Z ERROR upstream=loadbalancer-2 status=502 proxy_error="upstream prematurely closed connection"
```
Suspect a mix of abrupt client cancellations and upstream LB resets. Also seeing a small bump in gateway CPU at the time of errors.

bob-chen: checking infra -> ALB health looks green, but we see increased 5xx from gateway nodes (gateway-4, gateway-7). tcpdump from gateway-7 shows clients sending FIN before body complete. Could be client-side cancellation under slow network, but we shouldn't be surfacing 5xx for canceled clients.

dave-johnson: Support report — some customers seeing streaming responses drop mid-stream. A few high-profile customers on Dedicated reported ~2-3% session failures. No SLO breaches yet but customers are annoyed. I'm preparing a customer note if we need an incident page.

alice-nguyen: Agreed on mitigation plan: 1) Reduce gateway backpressure by increasing per-node worker threads + temporarily lower max concurrent streaming sessions. 2) Add immediate retry/fallback path that returns non-streaming complete response for clients that cancel mid-chunk. 3) Route traffic off gateway-7 while we capture full traces. I'll implement 1 and 3 now.

eve-ops: I'll coordinate a quick canary: take gateway-7 out of service, shift 25% traffic to gateway-2/5. Also raising keepalive timeout to 80s on the gateways to see if that reduces chunked EOFs.

carla-martin: Quick diagnostic command I ran:
```
# grep tx-9e4fd /var/log/gateway/*.log | tail -n 50
# kubectl logs gateway-7 -c gateway --since=10m | grep "Unexpected EOF"
```
Also found this pattern: chunk-size header present then immediate EOF. Points to client abort or early proxy reset.

alice-nguyen: deploy-bot: initiate drain on gateway-7 and bump worker pool on gateway-2/gateway-5 (scale +2 replicas).

deploy-bot: @alice-nguyen actioned: started drain for gateway-7. Scaled gateway deployment from 6 -> 8 replicas in prod. Scaling completes ~30s.

bob-chen: I've pulled recent ALB logs; these requests had backend response times around 55-120s before being reset. A couple of middleboxes (customer side) reported closing connections. But we also have internal proxy resets from gateway-7 at 18:00:10Z — investigating thread stack for SIGPIPE.

carla-martin: To reduce noise, I'm adding a filter in monitoring to not count client-cancelled streams as 5xx (we need to classify). But for now metric changes won't retroactively fix alerts. I'll publish an immediate alert annotation: "investigating client cancels vs gateway errors".

dave-johnson: Customer impact summary for now: ~130 unique sessions with abrupt streaming disconnects in the window; ~45 customers might have seen at least one failure. Top affected customers listed in the support queue (internal ticket links provided). Proactively notifying 5 affected customers that asked for updates.

alice-nguyen: Live mitigation results (10m after): 5xx dropped from 6.2% -> 0.9%, client disconnects down 12%. Draining gateway-7 seems to have removed a bad node contributing internal resets. Keepalive bump and scale helped too. Still seeing occasional chunked EOFs from long requests.

carla-martin: Next actions: collect full pcap from gateway-7 before we terminate instance, capture go runtime stacks around reset times, and run a reproducer against our client emulator that simulates slow upload + mid-stream cancel.

bob-chen: I'll own infra follow-up (collect pcaps, LB/ALB correlation) and follow up with network team. Assigning srx-123 to myself.

eve-ops: I'll file the incident page and mark impact level: P2 for now. Suggest postmortem to include: classify cancels (client v proxy), change to not surface 5xx for client-initiated cancels, and harden our chunked decoding to be defensive.

alice-nguyen: Handing off to night on-call @carla-martin for monitoring. I'm documenting runbook steps in the incident page and will do a short handover. If anything spikes, ping me directly.

carla-martin: Acknowledged. Will monitor dashboards and continue trace collection. Leaving a note: possible fix for long-term -> use idempotent resumable streaming protocol or early ack for chunk headers. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation applied (drain/gw-scale/keepalive), impact estimated: ~45 customers affected, immediate reduction in 5xx. Postmortem required. Incident channel: #incidents-1939001234.

alice-nguyen: Thanks team — great triage. I'll update after bob/carla have artifacts. Closing live mitigation loop but keeping incident open for postmortem artifacts and support comms. :thumbsup:
